primary_question: Can TRAIN-fitted unsupervised SAE refinement improve the fixed 512D frozen-scGPT embedding under held-out donor evaluation?
claim_C1: A specific mixed512 method shows reproducible within-Kang downstream improvement over original_h under the pre-specified exploratory development protocol.
claim_C2: Any improvement of an ensemble, AbsTopK, or Boosting is beyond the matched single-SAE or independent-bagging capacity control.
claim_C3: Improvement of sparse z-only readout is diagnostic and does not establish improvement of 512D embeddings.
forbidden_claims: unsupervised mixture hyperparameter selection (VALID labels select alpha)
improved reconstruction alone proves improved classification
